notice: The chapter sequence is used only as curriculum alignment. All explanations, examples, and practice activities on this site are original.

levels.label: B1 Foundation
levels.summary: Build reliable everyday language around identity, home, school, animals, colours, food, and family.

chapters.title: Jien u Int
chapters.summary: Introduce yourself, ask for another person's name, and describe simple personal qualities.

objectives.label: Introduce myself with my name and surname.
Recognise and use the Maltese alphabet.
Choose a basic masculine or feminine adjective.

pages.label: Introductions and Alphabet
pages.focus: Core language for names, spelling, and personal qualities.

pages.label: Pronouns and Possession
pages.focus: Use jien, int, hu, hi, aħna, intom, and huma.

pages.label: Grammar Path
pages.focus: Practise adjective agreement as a tracked grammar target.

chapters.title: Fejn Noqgħod
chapters.summary: Say where people live, how they travel, and what they see on a familiar route.

objectives.label: Use the present forms of noqgħod.
Say how somebody comes to school or work.
Describe simple things seen on a route.

pages.label: Pronouns and Possession
pages.focus: Keep each verb form with the correct personal pronoun.

pages.label: Transport and Travel
pages.focus: Practise bil-mixi, bil-karozza, and other transport phrases.

pages.label: Directions and Town
pages.focus: Connect routes with useful places and direction language.

chapters.title: L-Iskola
chapters.summary: Name places and objects at school and use the Maltese definite article in context.

objectives.label: Name common rooms and places at school.
Name common classroom objects.
Use the appropriate definite article with familiar words.

pages.label: School and Classroom
pages.focus: School vocabulary, articles, and classroom descriptions.

pages.label: Prepositions of Place
pages.focus: Place classroom objects on, under, next to, and between.

pages.label: Home, Rooms and Furniture
pages.focus: Reuse room vocabulary included in the chapter word bank.

chapters.title: L-Annimali
chapters.summary: Talk about pets, farm animals, and wild animals using possession and number.

objectives.label: Distinguish domestic, farm, and wild animals.
Use għandi, għandu, għandha, and għandhom.
Match common singular and plural animal forms.

pages.label: Animals
pages.focus: Review domestic, farm, sea, and wild animal vocabulary.

pages.label: Body and Appearance
pages.focus: Reuse body and appearance language in animal descriptions.

pages.label: Grammar Path
pages.focus: Practise the complete għandu possession pattern.

chapters.title: Il-Kuluri
chapters.summary: Agree colour adjectives with nouns and use demonstratives for people and objects.

objectives.label: Choose masculine, feminine, or plural colour forms.
Use dan, din, dawn, dak, dik, and dawk.
Describe simple flags and identify familiar countries.

pages.label: Colours in Maltese
pages.focus: Use colour forms in short object descriptions.

pages.label: Pronouns and Possession
pages.focus: Review near and far demonstratives.

pages.label: Grammar Path
pages.focus: Test near and far demonstratives by gender and number.

chapters.title: L-Ikel
chapters.summary: Name food and drink, express preferences, and use common food verbs.

objectives.label: Name familiar food and drink.
Recognise selected singular and collective food forms.
Use niekol, nixrob, and inħobb in short statements.

pages.label: Food Preferences
pages.focus: Meals, ingredients, preferences, and practical food language.

pages.label: The Collective
pages.focus: Compare unit, collective, and plural food forms.

pages.label: Restaurant and Ordering
pages.focus: Move from vocabulary to a practical food dialogue.

chapters.title: Il-Familja
chapters.summary: Describe family members and talk about routines during the week.

objectives.label: Name close and extended family members.
Use common present-tense routine verbs.
Say what people do on different days of the week.

pages.label: Family, Home and Food
pages.focus: Family vocabulary and short speaking models.

pages.label: Daily Routine
pages.focus: Connect family members with everyday actions.

pages.label: Numbers, Calendar and Time
pages.focus: Use weekdays and time expressions in routine answers.

levels.label: B2 Development
levels.summary: Extend the foundation with classroom instructions, weather, clothes, future plans, town tasks, and recycling.

chapters.title: Fil-Basket tal-Iskola
chapters.summary: Describe school objects with articles, demonstratives, and adjective agreement.

objectives.label: Name the main objects in a school bag.
Use demonstratives with classroom nouns.
Agree simple adjectives with school objects.

pages.label: School and Classroom
pages.focus: School-bag vocabulary and classroom description.

pages.label: Pronouns and Possession
pages.focus: Review demonstratives before describing objects.

pages.label: Grammar Path
pages.focus: Apply the regular and assimilated definite article.

chapters.title: Iftaħ il-Ktieb u Aqra
chapters.summary: Give classroom instructions in singular and plural and review core cardinal numbers.

objectives.label: Give a singular classroom command.
Give the corresponding plural command.
Use the cardinal numbers from one to ten.

pages.label: Imperative Verbs
pages.focus: Compare singular and plural command forms.

pages.label: Numbers, Calendar and Time
pages.focus: Review cardinal numbers in short instructions.

chapters.title: It-Temp
chapters.summary: Describe current weather, compare seasons, and make a simple weather-related plan.

objectives.label: Use common weather vocabulary.
Describe weather in different seasons.
Connect a future plan to the weather.

pages.label: Weather and Seasons
pages.focus: Weather words, seasonal models, and daily plans.

pages.label: Numbers, Calendar and Time
pages.focus: Connect seasons, dates, and temperature.

pages.label: Grammar Path
pages.focus: Build complete comparisons with minn.

chapters.title: Il-Ħwejjeġ
chapters.summary: Choose clothes for a season and combine numbers from eleven to twenty with nouns.

objectives.label: Name common clothes and accessories.
Choose suitable clothes for a season.
Use numbers from eleven to twenty with a noun.

pages.label: Shopping and Clothes
pages.focus: Clothes, sizes, colours, and shopping dialogues.

pages.label: Numbers, Calendar and Time
pages.focus: Review number patterns used with nouns.

pages.label: Grammar Path
pages.focus: Practise numbers 11–19 with -il and a singular noun.

chapters.title: Xi Nħobb Nagħmel
chapters.summary: Talk about hobbies and use se to describe a future activity.

objectives.label: Say which activities I like doing.
Build a future statement with se.
Ask what another person is going to do.

pages.label: Hobbies and Future Plans
pages.focus: Leisure activities, preferences, and future plans.

pages.label: Daily Routine
pages.focus: Compare a usual routine with a future plan.

pages.label: Imperative Verbs
pages.focus: Review the verb and command forms reused by the chapter.

pages.label: Verbs Guide
pages.focus: Review the se plus present-type form pattern.

pages.label: Grammar Path
pages.focus: Test future plans with se in recognition and production.

chapters.title: Fil-Pjazza
chapters.summary: Request something in a shop, write an address, and give short directions.

objectives.label: Name useful shops and public places.
Make a polite request in a shop.
Write an address and give short directions.

pages.label: Directions and Town
pages.focus: Places, routes, and short direction commands.

pages.label: Shopping and Clothes
pages.focus: Practise requests, prices, and customer dialogue.

pages.label: Places and Events
pages.focus: Extend town language to visits and local events.

pages.label: Restaurant and Ordering
pages.focus: Practise menu requests and a short customer dialogue.

pages.label: Grammar Path
pages.focus: Extend polite requests with can, must, want, and need patterns.

chapters.title: Nirriċiklaw l-Iskart
chapters.summary: Sort household waste and explain a simple recycling routine.

objectives.label: Name common recyclable materials.
Say where different waste should go.
Describe a simple household recycling routine.

pages.label: Environment and Recycling
pages.focus: Materials, containers, sorting, and practical eco-actions.

pages.label: Daily Routine
pages.focus: Place recycling actions in a weekly routine.

pages.label: Imperative Verbs
pages.focus: Practise the singular and plural commands used for sorting waste.
